name: KoboldCpp
what: A single executable around llama.cpp with its own web UI (Kobold Lite), the Kobold API and an OpenAI-compatible one; GGUF text models plus optional image, speech and embedding models in the same process. One model per launch, saved as a .kcpps config; in admin mode it relaunches itself into another config on request, which is how a dashboard swaps or unloads its model.

detect.configs: *.kcpps (the launch configs; --admindir names the folder the admin API may switch between)
detect.note: a unit is one .kcpps config; its model_id is the file's name as --admindir lists it, which is what the admin API loads. A server started without --admin can be seen and stopped but not swapped or unloaded.

auth.note: only when the server runs with --adminpassword: the file holds that password and nothing else

can: swap to a unit's config or unload the model through the admin API (the process relaunches itself; the port stays)
cannot: unload or swap a server started without --admin --admindir: stop it instead
hold two text models at once (its --routermode swaps per request on its own; one unit sees whatever is current)
drive.note: Table from the source of 1.124.2 (koboldcpp.py). Not yet driven from any machine.

never: --host 0.0.0.0 or --remotetunnel without --password: the UI and the API have no login otherwise
--adminpassword on the command line of a shared machine: others read it in the process list; the admin API is loopback-only here anyway

update.note: Each release is a new executable (about 600 MB with CUDA, 90 MB without): download it over the old one and restart the unit. The check compares /api/extra/version to the newest release.

windows: Download koboldcpp.exe (CUDA) or koboldcpp-nocuda.exe from the releases page into a folder of its own
Run it once: the launcher window picks the model and settings; Save Config writes a .kcpps
For swapping from Quartermaster, start it with --admin --admindir <that folder>

good: one download, no install, any GGUF, a UI of its own; the roleplay and story-writing community's server
image, speech and embedding models beside the text model in one process
not: long-context MoE at Strata's speeds: it is llama.cpp inside
a model store or pull command: bring the files
